title: Delhi DSSSB E Dossiers Form 2026
postName: e-Dossier submission for DSSSB selected / shortlisted candidates
vacancyDetails: Online e-Dossier upload for document verification after result / shortlist
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://dsssb.delhi.gov.in
2. Open e-Dossier / Candidate Login link
3. Login with roll number / registration details
4. Upload required documents in prescribed format
5. Submit e-Dossier before the board deadline
shortDescription: Delhi DSSSB e-Dossiers Form 2026 – upload documents online for verification after selection/shortlist on dsssb.delhi.gov.in.
content:
Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) requires shortlisted candidates to submit e-Dossiers online for document verification.

Candidates must login on the official DSSSB portal, upload educational, category, experience and identity documents as per the checklist, and submit within the notified dates. Incomplete dossiers can lead to cancellation of candidature.

Portal: dsssb.delhi.gov.in.
